scope: FBS functionality selected by the user; main tranches precede bonuses
constraints: Research and verify native FBS capabilities before implementing them
Use atomic commits and rigorous tests during implementation; end-to-end feature benchmarking can follow implementation
Development testing does not submit real bookings, amendments, cancellations or approvals
Do not replace an unsupported native amendment with cancellation/rebooking implicitly

main.feature: Batch review and execution with individual outcomes

evaluation_policy.applies_to: Every selected main feature and bonus; split-room planning is only an example
evaluation_policy.baseline: Codex CLI completing the same natural-language task with the previous tools and agent-written orchestration
evaluation_policy.measurements: Total reported model token usage and end-to-end completion time, with equivalent correctness and coverage
evaluation_policy.timing: Build and test the feature first; comparative benchmarking may come later
evaluation_policy.retention: Rework, consolidate or remove features that do not demonstrate worthwhile token and speed savings
evaluation_policy.evidence: Fewer tool calls, smaller payloads and backend timings alone do not establish end-to-end savings

excluded: Calendar/export features and all other unselected proposals
status: Main and four selected diagnostic/evaluation additions implemented. Initial 11-scenario synthetic Codex evaluation completed; broader per-feature retention evaluation remains open. Six scheduling/notification additions are deferred by the user.

quality_progress.verification_checkpoint: 596 tests passed on Python 3.12 and 3.14; live read-only failure PNG/support-bundle control passed without changing bookings
quality_progress.agent_evaluation: 11 scenarios, three repetitions per arm: 33 matched pairs, 66 accepted trials and 78 CLI invocations. All accepted trials passed their correctness checks; eight scenarios lowered both median tokens and elapsed time, three had mixed efficiency results.
quality_progress.remaining_evaluation: Synthetic timings exclude actual FBS latency and user-specific Codex configuration. Native catalogue/amendment/credits, saved preferences/shortlists/aliases, batches, classifications, multiple co-bookers and diagnosis-specific token savings still need matched end-to-end evaluation. Scenario feature tags are not automatic retention verdicts.

implementation_progress.verification_checkpoint: 596 tests passed on Python 3.12 and 3.14; native read-only controls are recorded in benchmarks/planning-functional-2026-11-15.json and benchmarks/diagnostics-functional-2026-11-15.json
limits: Room catalogue reports only exposed FBS fields; missing equipment/accessibility remains unknown and supplied photos may be representative
Credit balances and native form estimates are exposed; quota rules not present in the checked summary remain unknown
School/year person clues filter verified email domains and trailing year tokens; they do not independently verify enrolment information
Multi-co-booker native validation was tested with two exact directory selections in an unsent form, not a real submission
Native amendments expose verified date/time/purpose/classification fields only; the checked EDIT flow retains the room and existing participants and exposes no verified room-change control
Native amendment submission, lost-response reconciliation and batch writes are fixture-tested; live checks stop at unsent native forms and verify booking lists remain unchanged
Every implemented feature remains subject to the agreed end-to-end evaluation and retention policy
